records.title: India Science and Research Fellowship (ISRF) Programme
records.official_source: Indian National Science Academy (INSA) for Department of Science & Technology (DST), Govt. of India
records.deadline_display: For the 2025-26 cycle the call opened on 31 December 2025 and the official announcement states "Last date of proposal submission is 31 March 2026". That cycle has closed; the next annual call is expected to open around 31 December 2026 but no date is published yet.
records.application_period: Annual; applications received once a year by a Selection Committee. 2025-26 window: 31 December 2025 to 31 March 2026.

records.title: Fellowship for International Research Scholars in Technology at IIT Hyderabad (FIRST@IITH)
records.deadline_display: Official FIRST@IITH deadlines are intake-specific. For the January 2026 intake the page states "The application deadline was 07-November-2025 17:00 hrs IST". For the July 2026 intake it states "The last date to send the application by email is 30-April-2026, 17:00 hrs IST". Both have passed and no next-intake deadline has been published.
records.application_period: Two intakes a year, January and July. The January intake closes in early November and the July intake closes at the end of April.

records.title: University of Basel Financial Aid and Scholarships
records.deadline_display: The page publishes no central deadline. It links to a dedicated Submission Deadlines page under Advice and Support > Funding > Scholarships, and directs students to the scholarship office of their canton of residence, whose own deadlines apply.
records.application_period: Varies by fund. Cantonal education contributions are handled by the cantonal offices for Basel-Stadt and Basel-Landschaft; university supplementary scholarships follow the Senate scholarship committee's schedule, published on the Submission Deadlines page.

records.title: AAUW International Fellowships
records.deadline_display: Applications closed September 17, 2026, at 5:00pm ET for the 2027-28 academic year. AAUW states: 'Applications have closed for the 2027-28 academic year.'
records.application_period: Annual cycle. The 2027-28 window ran from August 17, 2026, 9:00am ET to September 17, 2026, 5:00pm ET; award notification March 2027.

records.title: Massey University Doctoral Scholarship
records.deadline_display: 1 October and 1 April each year; the 2026 round closed 1 October 2026
records.application_period: The published 2026 round opened 1 August 2026 and closed 1 October 2026. The award runs on a recurring cycle with closing dates of 1 October and 1 April, so the next window is the 1 April 2027 round.

records.title: Undergraduate International Study Grants (Massey University)
records.deadline_display: No application deadline - the grant is assessed at the point of admission for any 2027 intake
records.application_period: Any intake in the 2027 academic year. The official page shows Status: Open as at 2026-10-04.

records.title: Postgraduate International Study Grants (Massey University)
records.deadline_display: No application deadline - the grant is assessed at the point of admission for any 2027 intake
records.application_period: Any intake in the 2027 academic year. The official page shows Status: Open as at 2026-10-04.

records.title: Bond University Postgraduate Research Scholarship
records.deadline_display: 31 March 2027 (next round); rounds close 31 March and 30 September each year
records.application_period: Higher degree research scholarship rounds are held twice per year, opening 1 February and closing 31 March, then opening 1 August and closing 30 September. The 2026 round closed on 30 September 2026; the next window opens 1 February 2027.
